name: 엣지 안티앨리어싱 (비디오) 분석
description: Analyzes edge antialiasing in 비디오 frames
algorithm: Edge Antialiasing (Video) — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes edge anti-aliasing patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **에지감지&분류**: Edges are detected using multi-directional gradient operators and classified by type: natural edges (object boundaries, texture), compression edges (DCT block boundaries), and potential artifact edges (generation boundaries).

2. **Anti-Aliasing프로파일분석**: The sub-pixel transition profile at each edge is measured. Real camera capture produces edges with specific anti-aliasing characteristics determined by the optical low-pass filter and sensor sampling. AI-generated content often produces different edge profiles — either over-sharp (no optical AA) or artificially smoothed.

3. **에지일관성검증**: All edges in authentic video share the same optical pipeline, producing consistent anti-aliasing characteristics. The method compares edge profiles between face regions and background. Deepfake composites may show different AA characteristics in generated face regions versus original footage.

4. **시간적에지안정성**: Edge anti-aliasing should remain consistent across frames for stationary edges. The method tracks AA profiles temporally — deepfake generators may produce inconsistent sub-pixel edge rendering frame-to-frame, creating a temporal AA flicker not present in authentic video.

5. **해상도경계감지**: The method detects boundaries between regions of different effective resolution by analyzing edge sharpness gradients. Face-swap deepfakes may produce faces with different effective resolution than the background, creating a detectable resolution discontinuity at the face boundary.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)

accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through edge antialiasing (비디오) analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
